Signed Releases

Every claim below carries an Ed25519 signature. Verify any of them in your browser — no account, no asking, no trust.

Why this exists: a signed card posted to any public registry (Zenodo, Hugging Face, GitHub, arXiv) can be referenced and verified by anyone, without asking us. The signature makes the citation self-propagating — someone finds the card, checks the signature, cites it. Authority accrues because it's signed, not because it's advertised. The verifiability is the distribution.
